content: The Chronic Care Model (CCM) provides a structured approach to the management of chronic diseases, including diabetes. It emphasizes six fundamental components: Support for self-management is essential, empowering patients to take an active role in managing their condition through education and skill-building. 3. 4. Clinical information systems, such as patient registries, should be utilized to track and manage patient data efficiently, facilitating better care planning and follow-up. 5. Community resources should be leveraged to promote and sustain healthy lifestyle choices among patients. 6. Health systems should cultivate a culture that prioritizes quality improvement and patient-centered care.
